title: Preflight constraints and staged rollback procedures for hosted API soft launch
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Purpose: align cross-functional stakeholders on preflight gating criteria, mitigations for top release blockers, a three-stage rollback plan, and standard incident/rollback communications for a limited hosted API soft launch. This ticket centralizes runbook links, contact rotations, and ownership for rapid decisions during the first 72 hours of traffic ramp.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All gating checks documented and owners assigned. 2) Rollback playbook validated in staging with 1 simulated rollback. 3) Communication templates reviewed by Legal and Support. 4) On-call rota published and smoke dashboards shared with stakeholders. 5) Stakeholder sign-off captured in this ticket comments.
release_blockers: SLO regression >5% for 99th pct latency compared to baseline
Error-rate spike >1% for 10m on primary model endpoint
KV cache corruption discovered in staging persistency tests
Missing signed data processing addendum for enterprise beta customers
staged_rollback_plan: Stage 0: mitigation and traffic steering — enable autoscaler burst limits, apply route-level throttles, redirect non-critical traffic to brownout model variant. Stage 1: partial rollback — revert routing to previous stable model version in canary region and fail closed for new feature flags. Stage 2: full rollback — revert control plane config and restore traffic to last verified deployment; enable emergency read-only mode for impacted endpoints. Each stage has explicit go/no-go criteria (latency, error-rate, data integrity) and an owner responsible for execution and comms.
comms_templates: Internal Slack alert: short header + immediate impact (users, endpoints), current mitigation, owner + on-call contact, next update ETA
Customer-facing status note: neutral language, scope of impact, recommended mitigation for integrators (retries/backoff), when we expect next update
Legal & Sales escalation note: list of affected enterprise customers, data sensitivity checklist, proposed remediation timeline
Post-rollback retrospective request template: timeline, root-cause hypothesis, immediate follow-ups, action owners
incident_triggers_and_thresholds: Data integrity alert (KV mismatch) of any magnitude
Unrecoverable container crash loop >=3 restarts in 5m
on_call_rota: product-liaison: Priya Nambiar - Slack priority contact
support-escalation: Aisha Montgomery - enterprise support channel
stakeholders: Support & SRE: Aisha Montgomery, Jordan Lee
tasks: Lock final release config and bake canary image (ENG-5321)
Run staged rollback simulation in staging (ENG-5402)
Legal review comms templates and customer wording
Publish smoke dashboard and grant stakeholder read access
Confirm enterprise DPA signatures for beta customers
Run on-call dry-run and notification test
notes: We will limit initial traffic to 10% of baseline for 48 hours and then re-evaluate signals.
Fallback model variants are pre-warmed in two regions to reduce cold-start risk.
Support channel will use #launch-watch and follow template updates; PM will post hourly summaries during critical windows.
If a rollback occurs, schedule a cross-functional RCA within 72 hours and capture action items in the follow-up ticket.
